Welcome to the home of FTC Team 32516. Follow along as our team's story takes shape—from the first sketch to the competition field.

02 / THE CHALLENGE

More than a robot.

FTC connects hands-on engineering with teamwork and creative problem-solving.

01 — DESIGN & BUILD

Make ideas tangible.

Sketch a mechanism. Model its movement. Build a prototype. Mechanical engineering turns a concept into something you can test.

02 — CODE & CONTROL

Give it a purpose.

Software connects sensors, motors, and strategy. Each test is a chance to make a robot's behavior more reliable.

03 — LEARN & SHARE

Bring others along.

Documenting decisions and sharing discoveries make the learning useful beyond a single match or a single team.
